edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the settlement amount to be agreed in writing by the parties within ten (10) business days after this Agreement has been executed by all parties.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon the Plaintiff’s receipt of the settlement amount in cleared funds, the Plaintiff releases the Defendant from all claims, demands, and causes of action, whether known or unknown, that the Plaintiff asserted or could have asserted against the Defendant arising out of the facts and circumstances alleged in the action through the date this Agreement is executed. This release does not extend to claims to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its counsel, tax and financial advisers, and insurers, or as required by law. To the extent legally permitted, a party required to disclose the terms by law shall give the other party reasonable advance notice of the disclosure.
